summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @onereach/regex-helper@0.5.17 declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then invokes the downloaded `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to execute a package-local `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` rotator + custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`) that hides its behavior from static review. `setup.mjs` itself is written with obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and property-name-indirection wrappers around `fs`/`https`. The package's advertised purpose is a Vue regex helper, which has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque bundled payload. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to run on the installer's host at preinstall time under an out-of-tree runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
